# SG Car Workshop

> A directory of car workshops and car services in Singapore, run by Page One Singapore. Entries use details from the business or its public listing. Estate pages rank workshops only where there are at least 8 with 20 or more Google ratings, by rating and number of ratings together; paid Featured workshops are never ranked. No rating or review markup.

Last updated: 2026-11-04

## Services
- [Spray painting and bodywork](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/spray-painting-bodywork/): Respray, colour change and body kit work in a spray booth.
- [Gearbox repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/gearbox-repair/): Automatic gearbox diagnosis, repair, servicing and upgrades.
- [ABS, ECU and module repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/abs-ecu-module-repair/): Repair of ABS pumps and control modules instead of costly replacement.
- [Car battery replacement](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-battery/): Battery testing and replacement, at a workshop or where your car is.
- [Car detailing and coating](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-detailing-coating/): Grooming, steam cleaning, fumigation and odour removal for your car.
- [Car wrap and PPF](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-wrap-ppf/): Colour change wraps, paint protection film and window film.
- [Car parts](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-parts/): Parts shops for specific makes, with models and part types to browse.
- [Car aircon repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/car-aircon-repair/): Gas top-up, leak checks and aircon parts.
- [General servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/services/general-servicing-repair/): Everyday servicing and repairs: battery checks, alternators, aircon and more.

## Areas (regions)
- [North](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/north/): Car workshops and car services in the North region of Singapore, covering Woodlands, Kranji, Yishun and the Sembawang and Admiralty areas.
- [North-East](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/north-east/): Car workshops and car services in the North-East region of Singapore, covering Ang Mo Kio, Serangoon North, Defu and Hougang, and Sengkang.
- [East](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/east/): Car workshops and car services in the East region of Singapore, covering Kaki Bukit, Bedok North, Tampines and the Changi and Loyang areas.
- [West](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/west/): Car workshops and car services in the West region of Singapore, covering Toh Guan and Jurong East, Jurong West, Pandan Loop, Bukit Batok and Tuas.
- [Central](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/central/): Car workshops and car services in the Central region of Singapore, covering Sin Ming and Bishan, Toa Payoh, Ubi, Eunos, MacPherson, Jalan Besar and Kallang Bahru, and Alexandra and Bukit Merah.
- [Mobile (island-wide)](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/mobile/): Mobile car services that come to your car anywhere in Singapore. These listings have no single shopfront, so the work is done where your car is parked.

## Estates and industrial areas
- [Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/amk-industrial-park-2/): Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2 is an industrial estate in Ang Mo Kio, including the AMK AutoPoint motor building, with workshops serving the north-east. 4 listings.
- [Kaki Bukit Industrial Estate](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/kaki-bukit-industrial-estate/): Kaki Bukit is an industrial estate in the East region, around Kaki Bukit Avenue 4 and 6 and Kaki Bukit Road 2 and 4, with many workshops, trade units and parts suppliers. 27 listings.
- [Sin Ming Industrial Estate](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/sin-ming-industrial-estate/): Sin Ming Industrial Estate, including Sin Ming Drive and the Sin Ming AutoCity and Autocare buildings, is in the middle of Singapore near Bishan. 13 listings.
- [Toh Guan Road East and Enterprise Hub](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/toh-guan-enterprise-hub/): Toh Guan Road East and the Enterprise Hub industrial building are in the West region, near Jurong East. 15 listings.
- [Corporation Drive, Jurong East](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/corporation-drive-jurong-east/): Corporation Drive is an industrial road in Jurong East, in the West region. 3 listings.
- [Paya Ubi Industrial Park](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/paya-ubi-industrial-park/): Paya Ubi Industrial Park is around Ubi Avenue 1, near Paya Lebar in the Geylang planning area (Central region), with motor workshops mixed in among light industry. 5 listings.
- [Ubi Road 1](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/ubi-road-1/): Ubi Road 1 is an industrial road in the Ubi area, near Paya Lebar in the Geylang planning area (Central region). 3 listings.
- [Bedok Industrial Park E](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/bedok-industrial-park-e/): Bedok Industrial Park E is a block of trade units along Bedok North Avenue 4 in the East region, near Bedok Reservoir and Tampines. 2 listings.
- [Tampines Industrial Park A](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/tampines-industrial-park-a/): Tampines Industrial Park A is a light industrial estate along Tampines Street 92 and 93 in the East region. 1 listing.
- [Woodlands Industrial Park E9](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/woodlands-industrial-park-e9/): Woodlands Industrial Park E9 is the main industrial park in the north-west, close to the Causeway. 5 listings.
- [Jalan Lam Huat and Carros Centre](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/carros-centre-jalan-lam-huat/): Jalan Lam Huat, where Carros Centre stands, is an industrial road in the north-west of Singapore. 14 listings.
- [Woodlands Avenue 12 (Polaris@Woodlands)](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/woodlands-avenue-12/): Woodlands Avenue 12 and the Polaris@Woodlands industrial building are in the Woodlands area in the north. 2 listings.
- [Yishun Industrial Park A](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/yishun-industrial-park-a/): Yishun Industrial Park A is one of the two main motor trade clusters in Yishun, in the North region. 6 listings.
- [Yishun Industrial Street 1](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/yishun-industrial-street-1/): Yishun Industrial Street 1, around North Spring Bizhub and Northpoint Bizhub, is the second motor trade cluster in Yishun. 3 listings.
- [Bukit Batok Crescent (WCEGA Plaza)](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/bukit-batok-crescent/): Bukit Batok Crescent, home to the WCEGA Plaza and WCEGA Tower industrial buildings, is a light industrial area in the West region. 1 listing.
- [Woodlands Close (MEGA@Woodlands)](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/areas/woodlands-close/): Woodlands Close, where the MEGA@Woodlands industrial building stands, is a light industrial area in the north, near Woodlands Avenue 12. 1 listing.

## Car problem and brand guides
- [All guides](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/)
- [Car knocking or clunking over speed humps](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-knocking-over-humps/): Why a car knocks, clunks or rattles over humps and bumps, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for suspension and noise work.
- [Car aircon not cold](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-aircon-not-cold/): Why a car aircon blows warm or weak air, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for aircon servicing and repair.
- [Car won't start: battery, starter or something else?](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-wont-start-battery/): What the sounds mean when a car won't start, likely causes, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for starter and breakdown work.
- [Gearbox or CVT jerking, shuddering or slipping](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/gearbox-cvt-jerking/): Why an automatic gearbox or CVT jerks, shudders or hesitates, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for gearbox and fluid work.
- [Brake squeal, squeak or grinding](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/brake-squeal-noise/): Why brakes squeal, squeak or grind, which sounds can wait and which cannot, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for brake work.
- [Engine warning light on](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/engine-warning-light/): What the engine or check-engine light can mean, which cases need action now, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for diagnosis.
- [Car overheating](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/guides/car-overheating/): Why a car overheats, what to do when the temperature gauge rises, what to tell the workshop, and workshops customers mention for cooling work.
- [BMW and Mercedes-Benz servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/brands/bmw-mercedes/): What owners of BMW and Mercedes-Benz cars can ask an independent workshop, common maintenance topics, and workshops customers mention for these brands.
- [Toyota servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/brands/toyota/): What Toyota owners can ask a workshop, maintenance topics for common models including hybrids, and workshops customers mention for Toyota cars.
- [Honda servicing and repair](https://sgcarworkshop.sg/brands/honda/): What Honda owners can ask a workshop, maintenance topics for common models, and workshops customers mention for Honda cars.
